feeds.title: Colon Cancer Coalition
feeds.description: Learn more about the colon cancer community from our Colon Cancer Coalition blog. Stay in touch to know about recent developments, new volunteer opportunities, and more. Our mission is to empower local communities to promote the prevention and early detection of colon cancer and to provide support to those affected.

feeds.title: Fight Colorectal Cancer Blog
feeds.description: Read the Fight CRC blog for updates about colorectal cancer research, advocacy, and patient education. Fight Colorectal Cancer (Fight CRC) is the leading patient-empowerment and advocacy organization in the United States, providing balanced and objective information on colon and rectal cancer research, treatment, and policy.

feeds.title: Cancer Network » Colorectal Cancer
feeds.description: Updates for oncologists treating colon and rectal cancer, including guidelines, therapies, and screening by colonoscopy, FIT, stool DNA, and fecal occult blood tests.

feeds.title: ScienceDaily News » Colon Cancer
feeds.description: Information about cancer prevention, screening, symptoms, and treatments. Follow us to learn about the stages of colon cancer and cancer prognosis. Explore the latest research on colon cancer from ScienceDaily. ScienceDaily features breaking news about the latest discoveries in science, health, the environment, technology, and more -- from leading universities, scientific journals, and research organizations.

feeds.title: Colorectal Cancer Canada Blog
feeds.description: Stay informed about colorectal cancer. Read the CCC blog to learn more about colorectal cancer prevention, patient support, research and more. Colorectal Cancer Canada is the nation's not-for-profit colorectal cancer patient organization dedicated to colorectal cancer awareness and education, supporting patients and their caregivers, and advocating on their behalf.

feeds.title: The Bag for Life Blog
feeds.description: This is a personal blog written by a bowel cancer patient with the aim to raise awareness about what life with cancer is like. These are light-hearted personal accounts, aiming to give hope to those afflicted by cancer and their friends and families.

feeds.title: Medivizor Blog » Colorectal cancer
feeds.description: Medivizor provides people with serious or chronic medical conditions all the cutting edge information they need know personalized just for them. Medivizor's mission is to improve the lives of people with serious medical conditions and those who care for them and to effectively apply software and the social web in the field of health for the betterment of humanity.

feeds.title: Digestive Healthcare Center » Colon Cancer
feeds.description: This section features articles on colon cancer. Digestive Healthcare Center is a gastroenterology center in Hillsborough, NJ offering various gastroenterology procedures and digestive disease procedures.

feeds.title: Ben B. Brave
feeds.description: Ben B. Brave was diagnosed with stage three bowel cancer at 28 with no family history. This blog explores aspects of bot-bot cancer diagnosis, treatment and care.

feeds.title: Colon Cancer Foundation Blog
feeds.description: The Colon Cancer Foundation is a non-profit organization registered in New York State and listed by the Federal IRS as a public charity dedicated to reducing colorectal cancer incidence and death. Our mission is to lead the fight against colorectal cancer (CRC) by supporting research that will lead to the prevention of, therapy for, and eradication of CRC in our lifetime.

feeds.title: Colon Cancer Prevention Project News
feeds.description: We are a Louisville-based, nonprofit organization with one goal in mind: eliminating preventable colon cancer death and suffering in Kentucky and Southern Indiana! We have worked in our community to promote timely colon cancer screening and save lives. Our current programs include community education, digital outreach, public advocacy, health systems improvement, and survivor support!

feeds.title: Direct Endoscopy Blog
feeds.description: Bowel Cancer Screening is highly important especially after the age of 50. A colonoscopy offers the best chance of early detection and removal of pre-cancerous polyps. Find out more about bowel cancer prevention. Direct Endoscopy blog provides the latest news around bowel cancer testing, screening & prevention.

feeds.title: Nature » Colorectal cancer
feeds.description: Nature is the world's foremost international weekly scientific journal and is the flagship journal for Nature Research. Bringing you the latest science news, features, research and events from Nature Research on the topic of Colorectal Cancer.

feeds.title: Nature » Colon Cancer
feeds.description: Articles on colon cancer. Nature Portfolio is here to serve the research community by publishing its most significant discoveries - findings that advance knowledge and address some of the greatest challenges that we face as a society today.

feeds.title: MedPage Today » Colon Cancer
feeds.description: This section features articles on colon cancer. MedPage Today is a trusted source for clinical news coverage across the medical specialties. We cover all the clinical news, findings, and announcements that we think will directly affect the lives and practices of health care professionals throughout the U.S.
